slides.texte_overlay:
things i stopped doing that
made me smarter

no more skimming

i stopped skimming articles and started reading fewer, all the way through. i read less than before, but i actually remember what i read and can explain it to people.

no more pretending

i stopped nodding along when i didn't understand something and started asking. it felt embarrassing for a week, then it became the fastest way i've ever learned.

no more multitasking

i stopped doing two things at once, like eating while scrolling or working with the tv on. doing one thing at a time made my thinking clearer than any productivity trick.

no more wasted minutes

i stopped filling every queue and bus ride with my phone, and started learning one small thing instead: a word, a fact, a painting. five minutes a day added up fast.
slides.texte_sophia:
no more wasted minutes

i used to fill every queue with scrolling. now i spend those 5 minutes on one lesson in the Sophia app instead: a word, a fact, a painting. five minutes a day added up very fast.

slides.texte_overlay:
no more late nights

i stopped staying up past midnight for nothing in particular. a brain that sleeps well remembers more, thinks faster and argues less, and i notice it every single day.
